# Saint Charbel

> marsharbel.com is an independent devotional website about Saint Charbel Makhlouf (Mar Charbel, 1828-1898), the Lebanese Maronite monk, hermit and saint. It covers his life, the miracles attributed to his intercession, prayers and novenas, and the places in Lebanon that formed him, with sources cited on each page.

## History
- [Saint Charbel History](https://marsharbel.com/en/biography): full biography and timeline, 1828 birth in Bekaa Kafra to 1977 canonization.
- [How Did Saint Charbel Die](https://marsharbel.com/how-did-saint-charbel-die): his death on 24 December 1898 and what followed at the tomb.

## Miracles
- [Saint Charbel Miracles](https://marsharbel.com/miracles/): the canonization miracles, the signs at the tomb, and how recorded reports differ from Church-approved miracles.
- [Miracle of Nohad El Shami](https://marsharbel.com/miracles/nohad-el-shami): the 1993 healing that opened the canonization path.
- [Miracle of Dafne Gutierrez](https://marsharbel.com/miracles/dafne-gutierrez): the 2016 Arizona healing under Church review.

## Prayers
- [Saint Charbel Prayers](https://marsharbel.com/en/prayers): the curated collection of prayers for intercession and daily devotion.
- [Prayer Library](https://marsharbel.com/prayer-library): every prayer page on the site, organized by intention.

## Novena
- [Saint Charbel Novena](https://marsharbel.com/en/novena): the nine-day novena with daily prayers and how to pray it.
- [Saint Charbel Novena (full traditional text)](https://marsharbel.com/saint-charbel-novena): the complete traditional nine-day novena prayer text from the Annaya monastery.

## Feast Day
- [Saint Charbel Feast Day](https://marsharbel.com/saint-charbel-feast-day): why the feast is kept on 24 July and how it is celebrated at Annaya and worldwide.

## Annaya
- [Visit Annaya](https://marsharbel.com/visit-annaya): the monastery, tomb and hermitage - what to see, when to come, practical tips.

## Saints
- [Saints](https://marsharbel.com/saints): the saints and blesseds connected to Saint Charbel's story, from St Maroun to St Rafqa.

## Places
- [Saint Charbel Places in Lebanon](https://marsharbel.com/saint-charbel-places-lebanon): Bekaa Kafra, Annaya, the Qadisha Valley and the other holy places.
- [Qadisha Valley](https://marsharbel.com/qadisha-valley): the Holy Valley that formed the Maronite hermit tradition.

## Letters
- [Letters](https://marsharbel.com/testimonies): readers' letters about graces and experiences linked to Saint Charbel, moderated before publication.

## News
- [News](https://marsharbel.com/news): the latest Saint Charbel news and site updates.
